ns2:course.label: Organizational Theory for Educational Leaders
ns2:course.description: Study of theoretical perspectives and empirical research drawn from the social sciences relating to educational organizations and administrative leadership with an emphasis on application of theory to practice. Prerequisite: Student must be admitted to the EOL Superintendent Endorsement program or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: Student must be admitted to the EOL Superintendent Endorsement program or consent of instructor.
